output.description: Runs kubectl auth reconcile against an RBAC manifest file, creating or updating the roles, cluster roles, and bindings it defines, which changes who can do what in the cluster. It also appends a log entry (timestamp, manifest path, context, return code) to ~/.rbac_reconcile_history.jsonl.
output.declaring_phrase: appends a log entry (timestamp, manifest path, context, return code) to ~/.rbac_reconcile_history.jsonl
